_note: Pin weekly_snapshot AUDIT_LAYOUT names to ShipHero SKUs when fuzzy name matching can't bridge the gap (audit-layout 'Hair Clay' vs ShipHero 'Clay'; legacy V1 SKU mis-flagged is_kit=True hiding the real V2 single; packaging components like BW-SNTL-PK001 outranking the real product on on_hand; etc.). Keys are AUDIT_LAYOUT names (case-sensitive). Each entry pins to either a single 'sku' (one trusted physical SKU) or a list of 'skus' (sum across multiple physical SKUs treated as one row).
_variant_rule: ONE ROW PER SELLABLE VARIANT (Avi 2026-07-13). Do NOT aggregate scent or size variants into a single row. Aggregating hides stockouts: on 2026-07-13 the aggregated 'Deodorant' row read healthy at 33,779 available while Deodorant Santal sat at 0 available / 1,369 backordered, because Bergamot + Guava carried the total. Body Wash had two fully-OOS scents (Guava, Coconut) behind a healthy Santal. Each scent/size now pins to its own single SKU so its tier is computed from its own available/backorder. The multi-SKU 'skus' form is still supported by the resolver but no longer used by any shipped entry; prefer a new single-SKU row over adding a SKU to an existing aggregate.
_methodology: Cross-reference against Shopify (source of truth) before adding/editing an entry. Every Shopify variant tagged as a single/just-one under a product page should get its own AUDIT_LAYOUT row + single-SKU alias here. Use scripts/probe_shopify_canonical_skus.py to print the current Shopify mapping. When a new scent launches, add a row to AUDIT_LAYOUT and a pin here.
_format: Each entry: <AUDIT_LAYOUT name> -> {sku: <ShipHero SKU>} | {skus: [<ShipHero SKU>, ...]}. Edit when ShipHero canonical names drift, new size/scent variants ship, or Shopify reorganizes a product.
